summary: Highlights listed words by recolouring vertices, with no extra objects and no layout change.
overview: List the words and the colour each should take, and it tints them by recolouring the existing text mesh — no extra Image objects behind the text, no change to layout. Matching is by literal text, so every occurrence of a word gets the same treatment.
useCases: Colouring item or character names inside body text.
Highlighting keywords in a tutorial or help panel.
Rarity colours applied consistently wherever a name appears.

params.tuning: Re-applied when the text changes, so it survives the string being replaced.

gotchas.title: Literal matching catches substrings
gotchas.body: Highlighting "art" also colours the middle of "start". Distinct words, or rich-text tags, are the way round it.

gotchas.title: Use TMPTimedHighlighter for a timeline
gotchas.body: This addresses words by text, so every occurrence is the same colour at all times. Highlighting by position over time is a different component on purpose.
